title: Kayak & Paddleboard Rentals
seo_title: Kayak & Paddleboard Rentals | Heritage Harbor, Ottawa IL
seo_description: Rent Hobie Mirage Drive pedal kayaks and DuraGlide paddleboards at Heritage Harbor in Ottawa, IL. See rates, rules and the best way to see Starved Rock.
body_html:
The BEST way to see Starved Rock Country! Looking for an on-water adventure? Nothing beats the view from a Hobie. Our fleet of kayaks and paddleboards offers unique, easy-to-learn ways to see the scenery. Choose a Hobie DuraGlide stand-up paddleboard or a Hobie kayak featuring the patented MirageDrive pedal system, which makes it easier (and faster) than a traditional kayak. You will be amazed at how easy and fun pedaling or paddling can be.

Book your rental online

Available April 15 to October 1, weather permitting. Extended dates may be offered; please call.

Rental rules

  • Rentals launch from Heritage Harbor Marina. Check in at the marina office when you arrive.
  • Riders under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
  • Solo riders must be at least 14 years old and tall enough and physically able to operate the MirageDrive pedal system.
  • ALL riders must wear an approved personal flotation device (PFD or life jacket) at ALL times. Premium boarding or kayak PFDs are provided, or you can bring your own.
  • For safety, paddleboards are not allowed outside of the harbor.

Need help? Call the rental desk at 815-434-5001. Advance reservations are recommended so your equipment is ready and there are no surprises if your preferred ride is not available.

First time? You'll be pedaling like a pro in minutes

Hobie kayaks are very easy to learn and much more stable than ocean or rapids kayaks. We will help with proper pedal adjustment, after which you will be pedaling in minutes. Stand-up paddleboards require a bit more balance, but are still much easier to learn than you might think. If you have never used a stand-up paddleboard, watch this brief instructional video before your first rental. See also our paddleboarding guide. For beginners, paddling within the harbor is a chance to find your sea legs and enjoy the scenery.

Where you will paddle

Rentals launch from Heritage Harbor Ottawa, a protected, low-traffic, 32-acre marina and a great spot for beginners. From there, kayak riders only may venture out to the Illinois River and enjoy 12+ scenic miles between the Marseilles and Starved Rock locks.

River safety

The Illinois River outside the marina is a commercial waterway. It offers great scenery and numerous beaches and attractions, but you will share it with recreational boaters (busier on weekends and holidays) and occasional barges.

  • Stay close to shore where possible to avoid traffic and enjoy the best scenery.
  • Stay well clear of barges. They move slowly but cannot stop or turn quickly, and may not see smaller watercraft.
  • Remember there is a current. It is usually slow, but it will take longer to travel upstream than downstream, so plan your trip accordingly.

To learn more, call our rental desk at 815-434-5001. Thanks, and enjoy your ride!

faqs.q: Is the Illinois River safe for beginners?
